headline: Chloride Eastern Limited files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Exide Industries stake acquisition
sum: Chloride Eastern Limited has submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition or change in control position in Exide Industries Limited. The filing triggers regulatory review under India's takeover code and marks the entry of a competing player in the automotive battery sector.
detail: Chloride Eastern Limited, the battery and electrical equipment subsidiary of Chloride Industrial Batteries India Limited, has triggered the mandatory disclosure requirement under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within two trading days of crossing a disclosure threshold (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, etc.). This filing suggests Chloride Eastern has acquired or committed to acquire a material stake in Exide Industries, India's leading automotive battery and energy storage manufacturer. The disclosure mechanism is the formal gateway to open-offer, squeeze-out and shareholder protection provisions.
